I can’t quite remember all the things I ordered, so could you help me by listing them out? I just want to make sure I don’t miss anything.

Please reply with **one** of the following:
1) **Email address** used for the orders, **or**
2) **First name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I find your account, I’ll list your orders and what items are in each one, including which are **pending vs delivered**.

Thank you, I appreciate your understanding. My name is Amelia Silva, and my ZIP code is 19103. I hope that’s enough to pull up my account. If you need my email too, just let me know—I have a couple I use sometimes.

Thank you for sticking with me—I know I’m a bit all over the place right now. Let’s try my other email: amelia.silva7872@example.com. I really hope this one works, because I just want to get everything sorted and off my mind.
amelia_silva_7726
